title: go-orders · who does what when an order arrives

nodes.label: intake (run)
nodes.role: Reads orders from standard input and submits each one.

nodes.label: Handler
nodes.role: Routes an order and keeps the batch that waits to be written.

edgeCases.text: Submit holds h.mu for the whole call, including a priority order's write to the Store. While that write runs, the flush loop and every other Submit wait.

nodes.label: Limiter
nodes.role: Answers allow, defer or blocked for the customer.

nodes.label: flushLoop
nodes.role: A goroutine of the Handler that flushes the batch every 2 seconds.

nodes.label: FileStore
nodes.role: Appends a batch to the file with one write and syncs it.

steps.label: Submit(order)
steps.note: The client hands one order to the Handler.

steps.label: Allow(customerID, now)
steps.note: The Handler asks whether this customer may submit now.

steps.label: VerdictAllow
steps.note: The customer is under the soft limit.

steps.label: process(&o)
steps.note: Three ordered steps prepare the order.

steps.label: enqueue(o)
steps.note: The order joins the batch. Nothing is written yet.

steps.label: Queued
steps.note: The client is told that the order waits for a flush.

steps.label: WriteBatch([order])
steps.note: A priority order skips the batch and is written at once, while the Handler's lock is held.

steps.label: Forget(now)
steps.note: Windows that ended are removed, so the map does not grow forever.

steps.label: releaseDeferred()
steps.note: Orders held back by the soft rate limit join the batch.

steps.label: flushLocked()
steps.note: The whole batch is written with one call.

steps.label: nil
steps.note: The batch is emptied and its bytes are released.

steps.label: error
steps.note: The file could not be written. Nothing of the batch was stored.

steps.label: error, ignored
steps.note: flushLocked returns the error and the loop drops it. The batch and its bytes stay in memory.

steps.label: flushLocked()
steps.note: Two seconds later the next tick tries again with the same batch.

steps.label: nil
steps.note: This time the write succeeds and the batch is emptied.

steps.label: reserve: over the hard limit
steps.note: The order's bytes would take pendingBytes to 8 MiB or more. The Handler stops for good.

steps.label: Rejected, ErrOverloaded
steps.note: The order is refused, and so is every order after it.

steps.label: Close()
steps.note: The client stops reading and closes the Handler, which still writes what it had accepted.
